summary: Colliers International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and supplemental presentation announcing Q2 2026 financial results. The release details double-digit revenue growth across three platforms, with consolidated revenues of $1.57 billion, up 17%, adjusted EBITDA of $205.3 million, up 14%, and adjusted EPS of $1.83, up 6%. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.56. No special-situation corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings report. The mention of acquisition costs related to Ayesa Engineering is ancillary and not the subject of the filing.
